description: UTM grid is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. This dataset contains vector data representing mesh lines UTM (Universe Transverse Mercator) on the national territory of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. This data can be useful for the creation of maps in GIS systems. Coverage: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. The publisher named on the listing is Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. Its keywords include utm, geodonnees, map, development, nature, geodaten. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
